input.description: Path to the (untarred) BCL files. Expects 'RunParameters.xml' at './'.
input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `/path/to/bcl`

sample_sheet.description: The path to the sample sheet.
sample_sheet.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `SampleSheet.csv`

output.description: The folder to store the demux results
